description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
